CustomCondition.text: If a condition or partial condition cannot be formulated in the A12 validation language, _CustomCondition_ can be used.  Every custom condition must have a name. The evaluation must be implemented by the system calling this condition.
CustomCondition.title: CustomCondition _Name_)

ValueAsDate.text: Returns a specific date corresponding to the DateSpecification of a partially known date.
ValueAsDate.title: ValueAsDate(_Field_, _DateSpecification_)

CurrentRepetition.text: If the rule iterates over _group_, the operator returns the respective repetition index of the group. If _group_ is used with a semantic index, the repetition which correspondes to the value of the index field is returned.
CurrentRepetition.title: CurrentRepetition(_Group_)

DiffersWithToleranceRange5.text: _Field1_ differs from _Field2_ with a tolerance of 5, i.e. the absolute value of [Field1] minus [Field2] is greater than 5
DiffersWithToleranceRange5.title: [_Field1_] DiffersWithToleranceRange5 [_Field2_]

DiffersWithToleranceRange10.text: _Field1_ differs from _Field2_ with a tolerance of 10, i.e. the absolute value of [Field1] minus [Field2] is greater than 10
DiffersWithToleranceRange10.title: [_Field1_] DiffersWithToleranceRange10 [_Field2_]

DiffersWithToleranceRange1.text: _Field1_ differs from _Field2_ with a tolerance of 1, i.e. the absolute value of [Field1] minus [Field2] is greater than 1
DiffersWithToleranceRange1.title: [_Field1_] DiffersWithToleranceRange1 [_Field2_]

DiffersWithToleranceRange2.text: _Field1_ differs from _Field2_ with a tolerance of 2, i.e. the absolute value of [Field1] minus [Field2] is greater than 2
DiffersWithToleranceRange2.title: [_Field1_] DiffersWithToleranceRange2 [_Field2_]

PatternMatched.text: The value of _StringField_ matches the regular expression _RegExp_.
PatternMatched.title: _StringField_ PatternMatched _RegExpr_

False.text: The Boolean value _False_ as a constant.
False.title: False

FirstDay.text: A specification that indicates that, using _ValueAsDate_ a partially known date should be replaced with the earliest possible date.
FirstDay.title: FirstDay

LastDay.text: A specification that indicates that, using _ValueAsDate_, a partially known date should be replaced with the latest possible date.
LastDay.title: LastDay

Valid.text: If the parameter _CustomType_ is specified, the evaluation checks if the value of _Field_ is valid in relation to the CustomType. Otherwise, the evaluation ensures that Field is a valid date.
Valid.title: Valid(_Field_, _CustomType_)

ValueNotConsistent.text: The value of _Field_ does not match the values in _ValueList_.
ValueNotConsistent.title: ValueNotConsistent(_Field_ TO _ValueList_)

Invalid.text: If the parameter _CustomType_ is specified, the evaluation checks if the value of _Field_ is invalid in relation to the CustomType. Otherwise, the evaluation ensures that Field is a invalid date.
Invalid.title: Invalid(_Field_, _CustomType_)

True.text: The Boolean value _True_ as a constant.
True.title: True

PatternViolated.text: The value of _StringField_ violates the regular expression _RegExp_.
PatternViolated.title: _StringField_ PatternViolated _RegExp_

FieldValueIncludedInValueList.text: _Field_ is filled and its value is included in _ValueList_; here, __ValueList__ is either a list of constants or a list of Field values like [F1], [F2], [F3].
FieldValueIncludedInValueList.title: FieldValueIncludedInValueList(_Field_, _ValueList_)

FieldValueNotIncludedInValueList.text: _Field_ is filled and its value is not included in _ValueList_; here, __ValueList__ is either a list of constants or a list of Field values like [F1], [F2], [F3].
FieldValueNotIncludedInValueList.title: FieldValueNotIncludedInValueList(_Field_, _ValueList_)

NoFieldFilled.text: No value is given for any of the fields in _FieldList_.
NoFieldFilled.title: NoFieldFilled(_FieldList_)

AtLeastOneFieldFilled.text: For at least one field in _FieldList_ a value is given.
AtLeastOneFieldFilled.title: AtLeastOneFieldFilled(_FieldList_)

NotExactlyOneFieldFilled.text: Either none or else more than one of the fields in _FieldList_ are filled.
NotExactlyOneFieldFilled.title: NotExactlyOneFieldFilled(_FieldList_)

MoreThanOneFieldFilled.text: For more than one field in _FieldList_ a value is given.
MoreThanOneFieldFilled.title: MoreThanOneFieldFilled(_FieldList_)

NotAllFieldsFilled.text: A value is not given for all fields in _FieldList_.
NotAllFieldsFilled.title: NotAllFieldsFilled(_FieldList_)

FieldsNotCollectivelyFilled.text: For at least one field but not for all fields in _FieldList_ a value is given.
FieldsNotCollectivelyFilled.title: FieldsNotCollectivelyFilled(_FieldList_)

AllFieldsFilled.text: For all fields in _FieldList_ a value is given.
AllFieldsFilled.title: AllFieldsFilled(_FieldList_)

RepetitionNotUnique.text: There are at least two instances of the rule iteration for which the fields in _FieldList_ have the same values.
RepetitionNotUnique.title: RepetitionNotUnique(_FieldList_)

FieldValuesNotUnique.text: At least two fields in _FieldList_ share the same value.
FieldValuesNotUnique.title: FieldValuesNotUnique(_FieldList_)

NoFieldValueIncludedInValueList.text: No field value in _FieldList_ is contained in _ValueList_; here, _ValueList_ is either a list of constants or a Field list.
NoFieldValueIncludedInValueList.title: NoFieldValueIncludedInValueList(_FieldList_ IN _ValueList_)

AtLeastOneFieldValueIncludedInValueList.text: One or more field values in _FieldList_ are included in _ValueList_; here, _ValueList_ is either a list of constants or a Field list.
AtLeastOneFieldValueIncludedInValueList.title: AtLeastOneFieldValueIncludedInValueList(_FieldList_ IN _ValueList_)

NotAllFieldValuesIncludedInValueList.text: For at least one field in _FieldList_, a value is given but this value is not included in _ValueList_; here, _ValueList_ is either a list of constants or a Field list.
NotAllFieldValuesIncludedInValueList.title: NotAllFieldValuesIncludedInValueList(_FieldList_ IN _ValueList_)

GroupFilled.text: For at least one field of _Group_ a value is given.
GroupFilled.title: GroupFilled(_Group_)

GroupNotFilled.text: No value is given for any field of _Group_.
GroupNotFilled.title: GroupNotFilled(_Group_)

NoGroupFilled.text: No group in _GroupList_ contains a field that is filled.
NoGroupFilled.title: NoGroupFilled(_GroupList_)

AtLeastOneGroupFilled.text: There is a group in _GroupList_ that contains a field which is filled.
AtLeastOneGroupFilled.title: AtLeastOneGroupFilled(_GroupList_)

NotAllGroupsFilled.text: There is a group in _GroupList_ that is not filled.
NotAllGroupsFilled.title: NotAllGroupsFilled(_GroupList_)

GroupsNotCollectivelyFilled.text: At least one but not all groups in _GroupList_ are filled.
GroupsNotCollectivelyFilled.title: GroupsNotCollectivelyFilled(_GroupList_)

FieldValueAsString.text: Returns the value of _Field_ as a string.
FieldValueAsString.title: FieldValueAsString(_Field_)

FieldValueAsNumber.text: Returns the value of _Field_ as a number.
FieldValueAsNumber.title: FieldValueAsNumber(_Field_)

RangeAsString.text: Returns the substring of _Field_ given by _Start_ and _End_ as a string.
RangeAsString.title: RangeAsString(_Field_, _Start_, _End_)

RangeAsNumber.text: Returns  the substring of _Field_ given by _Start_ and _End_ as a number.
RangeAsNumber.title: RangeAsNumber(_Field_, _Start_, _End_)

NumberOfFilledFields.text: Returns the number of filled fields in _FieldList_.
NumberOfFilledFields.title: NumberOfFilledFields(_FieldList_)

NumberOfFilledGroups.text: Returns the number of filled groups in _GroupList_.
NumberOfFilledGroups.title: NumberOfFilledGroups(_GroupList_)

NumberOfDifferentValues.text: Returns the number of different values of the fields in _FieldList_.
NumberOfDifferentValues.title: NumberOfDifferentValues(_FieldList_)

FirstFilledValue.text: Returns the value of the first filled field in _FieldList_.
FirstFilledValue.title: FirstFilledValue(_FieldList_)

NumberOfValueInFields.text: Returns the number of fields in _FieldList_ with value _Constant_.
NumberOfValueInFields.title: NumberOfValueInFields(_Constant_ IN _FieldList_)

RoundDown.text: Returns _Value_, rounded down to _DecimalPlaces_ decimal places. The parameter _DecimalPlaces_ is optional.
RoundDown.title: RoundDown(_Value_, _DecimalPlaces_)

RoundUp.text: Returns _Value_, rounded up to _DecimalPlaces_ decimal places. The parameter _DecimalPlaces_ is optional.
RoundUp.title: RoundUp(_Value_, _DecimalPlaces_)

RoundAccounting.text: Returns _Value_, rounded to the nearest number with _DecimalPlaces_ decimal places. The parameter _DecimalPlaces_ is optional.
RoundAccounting.title: RoundAccounting(_Value_, _DecimalPlaces_)

RoundDownValue.text: Returns the value of _Field_, rounded down to _DecimalPlaces_ decimal places. The parameter _DecimalPlaces_ is optional.
RoundDownValue.title: RoundDown(_Field_, _DecimalPlaces_)

RoundUpValue.text: Returns the value of _Field_, rounded up to _DecimalPlaces_ decimal places. The parameter _DecimalPlaces_ is optional.
RoundUpValue.title: RoundUp(_Field_, _DecimalPlaces_)

RoundAccountingValue.text: Returns the value of _Field_, rounded to the nearest number with _DecimalPlaces_ decimal places. The parameter _DecimalPlaces_ is optional.
RoundAccountingValue.title: RoundAccounting(_Field_, _DecimalPlaces_)

Length.text: Returns the number of characters of the value of _Field_.
Length.title: Length(_Field_)

Max.text: Returns the maximum of the values in _ValueList_.
Max.title: Max(_ValueList_)

Min.text: Returns the minimum of the values in _ValueList_.
Min.title: Min(_ValueList_)

MaxValue.text: Returns the maximum value of the fields in _FieldList_.
MaxValue.title: MaxValue(_FieldList_)

MinValue.text: Returns the minimum value of the fields in _FieldList_.
MinValue.title: MaxValue(_FieldList_)

Sum.text: Returns the sum of the values of the filled fields in _FieldList_.
Sum.title: Sum(_FieldList_)

SumOfProducts.text: For each repetition, the product of two repeatable fields is calculated. The results are summed up.
SumOfProducts.title: SumOfProducts(_Field1_, _Field2_)

SumOfTerms.text: For each repetition, the value of an iterating term is calculated and then those values are summed up.
SumOfTerms.title: SumOfTerms(_Path_, _Term_)

DifferenceInYears.text: Returns the difference of the two date values in years.
DifferenceInYears.title: DifferenceInYears(_Date1_, _Date2_)

DifferenceInMonths.text: Returns the difference of the two date values in months.
DifferenceInMonths.title: DifferenceInMonths(_Date1_, _Date2_)

DifferenceInDays.text: Returns the difference of the two date values in days.
DifferenceInDays.title: DifferenceInDays(_Date1_, _Date2_)

DifferenceInHours.text: Returns the difference of the two date values in hours.
DifferenceInHours.title: DifferenceInHours(_DateTime1_, _DateTime2_)

DifferenceInMinutes.text: Returns the difference of the two date values in minutes.
DifferenceInMinutes.title: DifferenceInMinutes(_DateTime1_, _DateTime2_)

DifferenceInSeconds.text: Returns the difference of the two date values in seconds.
DifferenceInSeconds.title: DifferenceInSeconds(_DateTime1_, _DateTime2_)

AddYears.text: Returns _Date_ plus _Integer_ years. _Integer_ may be negative.
AddYears.title: AddYears(_Date_, _Integer_)

AddMonths.text: Returns _Date_ plus _Integer_ months. _Integer_ may be negative.
AddMonths.title: AddMonths(_Date_, _Integer_)

AddDays.text: Returns _Date_ plus _Integer_ days. _Integer_ may be negative.
AddDays.title: AddDays(_Date_, _Integer_)

AddHours.text: Returns _Date_ plus _Integer_ hours. _Integer_ may be negative.
AddHours.title: AddHours(_DateTime_, _Integer_)

AddMinutes.text: Returns _Date_ plus _Integer_ minutes. _Integer_ may be negative.
AddMinutes.title: AddMinutes(_DateTime_, _Integer_)

AddSeconds.text: Returns _Date_ plus _Integer_ seconds. _Integer_ may be negative.
AddSeconds.title: AddSeconds(_DateTime_, _Integer_)

DayFromDate.text: X can be Date or DateTime. Returns the day of the date value as a number.
DayFromDate.title: DayFromDate(_X_)

MonthFromDate.text: X can be Date or DateTime. Returns the month of the date value as a number.
MonthFromDate.title: MonthFromDate(_X_)

YearFromDate.text: X can be Date or DateTime. Returns the year of the date value as a number.
YearFromDate.title: YearFromDate(_X_)

QuarterFromDate.text: X can be Date or DateTime. Returns the year of the date value as a number. Returns the quarter of the date value as a number between 1 and 4.
QuarterFromDate.title: QuarterFromDate(_X_)

HoursFromTime.text: X can be Time or DateTime. Returns the hours of the date value as a number.
HoursFromTime.title: HoursFromTime(_X_)

MinutesFromTime.text: X can be Time or DateTime. Returns the minutes of the date value as a number.
MinutesFromTime.title: MinutesFromTime(_X_)

SecondsFromTime.text: X can be Time or DateTime. Returns the seconds of the date value as a number.
SecondsFromTime.title: SecondsFromTime(_X_)

DateRange.text: Returns the date range which starts with _Date1_ and ends with _Date2_.
DateRange.title: DateRange(_Date1_, _Date2_)

StartOfDateRange.text: Returns the start date of the date range.
StartOfDateRange.title: StartOfDateRange(_DateRange_)

EndOfDateRange.text: Returns the end date of the date range.
EndOfDateRange.title: EndOfDateRange(_DateRange_)

Date.text: Combines the parameters and returns the corresponding constant of type Date. The parameter _Century_ is optional.
Date.title: Date(_Day_, _Month_, _Century_, _Year_)

Time.text: Combines the parameters and returns the corresponding constant of type Time.
Time.title: Time(_Hours_, _Minutes_, _Seconds_)

DateTime.text: Combines the parameters and returns the corresponding constant of type DateTime.
DateTime.title: DateTime(_Date_, _Time_)

Now.text: Returns the current date and the current time.
Now.title: Now

BaseYear.text: Returns the base year set for the model. For example, using ``YearFromDate(BaseYear)`` in a model with base year 2021, the number 2021 would be returned.
BaseYear.title: BaseYear

DateRangesOverlap.text: The date ranges specified by _FieldList_ overlap.
DateRangesOverlap.title: DateRangesOverlap(_FieldList_)

AtLeastOneDateRangeOverlaps.text: The date range of _Field_ overlaps with the date range of at least one field in _FieldList_.
AtLeastOneDateRangeOverlaps.title: AtLeastOneDateRangeOverlaps(_Field_ IN _FieldList_)
